name: grammar
description: Checks the English (or another language you set, or whatever language each prompt is in) of each prompt you send to Claude Code, shows the fixes under it, and keeps them so /grammar stats and /grammar review show the mistakes you make most, and /grammar ask answers your questions about them. Sends each prompt you type to Haiku (one small call per prompt), and the kept fixes to Sonnet when you run /grammar review or /grammar ask, through your own Claude Code session, or all of it to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you set (llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama, OpenRouter)

enabled.title: Check my prompts
enabled.description: Send each prompt you type to the model for a grammar check. /grammar on|off sets this too.

natural.title: Native-speaker line
natural.description: Also show how a native speaker would say a sentence when the phrasing is clearly off. /grammar natural on|off sets this too.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that checks each prompt. Sonnet catches more and costs more.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks about each prompt. Higher is slower and costs more.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language your prompts are checked in, named in English (English, French, German, Japanese...). Prompts in other languages are skipped. auto checks each prompt in whatever language it is written in.

dialect.title: Spelling
dialect.description: For English: any accepts US and UK spelling alike; us or uk flags the other one's spellings.

min_words.title: Minimum words
min_words.description: Prompts with fewer words than this (ok, yes, continue) are not checked.

max_chars.title: Maximum characters
max_chars.description: How much of a long prompt is checked (and sent), cut at a word boundary.

icons.title: Nerd Font icons
icons.description: In the terminal, off draws plain characters for terminals without a Nerd Font. The desktop app always draws plain characters.

show_why.title: Show why
show_why.description: Show the short reason after each fix.

desktop.title: In the desktop app
desktop.description: The desktop app doesn't draw the line under your prompt. band shows the fixes in color in a band above the prompt box, and also as a dim line in the transcript; line only the dim line; toast shows them briefly as a toast; off shows nothing there.

history.title: Keep my fixes
history.description: Keep each fix in grammar-history.json in your Claude Code folder for /grammar stats and /grammar review. /grammar history on|off sets this too.

clean.title: Mark clean prompts
clean.description: A green check before a prompt with no mistakes, and from 3 in a row, how many in a row. In the desktop app it shows in the band, the transcript line or a toast, as the desktop setting says.

ask_memory.title: Remember asks
ask_memory.description: /grammar ask remembers the last 5 asks and reviews of the session, so you can ask follow-ups. Off, each ask starts fresh. /grammar ask memory on|off sets this too.

cowork.title: Fixes in Cowork replies
cowork.description: Cowork tasks show no plugin output, so there each prompt waits a second or two for its check, and Claude ends its reply with the fixes. Off, Cowork prompts are not checked.

endpoint.title: OpenAI-compatible endpoint
endpoint.description: An OpenAI-compatible API to use instead of Claude's models for the checks, /grammar review and /grammar ask: local (http://localhost:9931 for llama.cpp) or not (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1). Your prompts then go there. Empty: Claude's models.

endpoint_model.title: Endpoint model
endpoint_model.description: The model to ask the endpoint for, like gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat. Empty: the endpoint's default. Used only when the endpoint is set.

endpoint_key.title: Endpoint API key
endpoint_key.description: Sent as a Bearer token to the endpoint, when it needs one. Kept in secure storage, not settings.json.
